```yaml
name: Windows Installer

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up MSYS2
        uses: msys2/setup-msys2@v2
        with:
          msystem: MINGW64
          path-type: inherit
          update: true
          install: >-
            base
            mingw-w64-x86_64-toolchain
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3
            mingw-w64-x86_64-cmake
            mingw-w64-x86_64-ninja

      - name: Provision MSYS2 packages
        shell: msys2 {0}
        run: |
          ./provision-msys2.sh

      - name: Build OpenPLC Runtime
        shell: msys2 {0}
        run: |
          cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          ninja -C build

      - name: Download Inno Setup
        run: |
          curl -L -o InnoSetup-6.2.0.exe https://files.jrsoftware.org/is/6/innosetup-6.2.0.exe
          InnoSetup-6.2.0.exe /VERYSILENT /SUPPRESSMSGBOXES /NORESTART /SP-

      - name: Build installer with Inno Setup
        run: |
          "C:\Program Files (x86)\Inno Setup 6\iscc.exe" setup.iss /O"output" /F"OpenPLC_Runtime_Installer.exe"
        shell: cmd

      - name: Upload installer artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: installer
          path: output/OpenPLC_Runtime_Installer.exe

      - name: Set tag name
        id: set_tag
        run: |
          if ($env:GITHUB_EVENT_NAME -eq 'push') {
            echo "TAG_NAME=$env:GITHUB_REF_NAME" >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT
          } else {
            echo "TAG_NAME=manual-build-$env:GITHUB_RUN_ID" >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT
          }

      - name: Create release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ steps.set_tag.outputs.TAG_NAME }}
          release_name: ${{ steps.set_tag.outputs.TAG_NAME }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Upload installer to release
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: output/OpenPLC_Runtime_Installer.exe
          asset_name: OpenPLC_Runtime_Installer_${{ steps.set_tag.outputs.TAG_NAME }}.exe
          asset_content_type: application/octet-stream
```
